<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary deadlock:</strong> The Monsoon Session faces a potential washout as the Opposition continues to disrupt proceedings, prompting Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla to urge for an end to the logjam.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Government response:</strong> Home Minister Amit Shah has expressed readiness to debate the ongoing student protests, while NDA MPs are organizing a march to Parliament to counter the Opposition&#x27;s refusal to engage in parliamentary business.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative progress:</strong> Despite the ongoing disruptions, Parliament has successfully passed the Bankers’ Books Evidence Bill, 2026, and a bill to establish a selection panel for tribunal chiefs and members.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQb2VFcXRsTU1YZUhvVmVyelRtbnlDUGNUYU5yenp4ZVFYeG5HRnRTblQzZlpER3RYQ05ZUkdhOUJtTnlnOHJOVy11bENXYndZbzFSak5aMGZKRVR0cjhURThzTHFPajI4aW54MmhaeHFwdlF4bllvT1JBMFNTRkZ2MnpfQ0JpRTRFa0lIcnFIbU5OQjJrYTdqbzRXbXdweWozYlZB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission coordination:</strong> The Election Commission of India and State Election Commissioners concluded a National Round Table Conference in New Delhi to discuss electoral governance.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Welfare oversight:</strong> A parliamentary panel has flagged significant concerns regarding the poor utilization of minority and OBC welfare schemes, alongside delays in the disbursement of Scheduled Caste scholarships.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
